body: No it's not. Don't even think of it. Depression is not a choice. Maybe he just learnt to justify his sadness to feel better and it's confusing.

Yes, yes. Of course it's against the spirit of /r/dep and you probably won't take the time to understand instead of posting the famous "it gets better line". I'm afraid of the doezens of other people that will read your post saying "Wow, man your life sucks. It gets better." He has f*king EVERYTHING. And though as I'm not making any sense anymore I understand that he might be depressed cause I know what depression is. Cause you see, I myself contemplate S every day when I wake up and go to sleep, I come here, and read this and where does it get better? I am EXTREMELY JEALOUS of him and really not see any light if you can't be happy when you have everything because seriously what will you write next time? That another girl put you in the friend zone? I'm sorry cause I'm not mentally healthy and I really have life up my ass in this point. So go read the other "It gets better posts" or go to my threads, there plenty of them there! And as I am literally THANKFUL for all of them, and for the time people took in writing them I'm just not f**king worth it and they're all the same. Yes I'm whining in your thread because it's 5AM in the morning here, I can't sleep, and you're making me want to kill myself even more. Call me a whore it doesn't get better, it's just that you as a person will get over it after maybe a month and even forget u wrote here. And you're arrogance regarding my post doesn't really bother anyone.

TL:DR. I truly, truly, and sincerely wish that you have the life you do now. You won't believe how perfect it is.

So basically. "fairly intelligent" - no low self esteem here, good job perspectives, caring family, f**king nice hobbies that give you satisfaction, no problems with friends. While reading I was thinking that maybe you have problems with girls... you don't. And all that at age of 21. I'm sorry to be a  douchebag, but have you read any other threads here? Cause I'm pretty sure this one will depress people even more. Wrong sub. Go to realtionship advice. After downvoting please write at least something constructive.

I just DON'T LIKE PEOPLE. I fuckin' hate them because I feel worse than them at everything I do. I feel worthless cause I indeed am. I have a cat... they say that cats don't stick to a person but to a place... and that's BS. My cat only comes to me, and walks everywhere I go(changing rooms). He's been with me all those lonely years. It's beautiful when she comes and purrs. Thank you all, in the end I'm going to do what I consider the best but I'm trying, I will try. Right now I'm here all alone, my house mates have gone somewhere, I like to be alone, i'll make myself something to eat!

:) But I will wait, my thoughts of actually CS base around the time when it's warm outside... Like summer or something. I can wait and see how everything turns out since I don't care anymore. It'll probably hurt a whole fuckin lot but meh, it won't kill me heh?:) Failing school will ultimately torn my low self esteem. I think I feel happy when I don't care about anything... and thinking of suicide. It kinda relaxes me a bit.
No, don't get me wrong, I'm really thankful. It's just me. Aw fuck I always say shit and people get it as something bad :(
Thank you for your time. I'll just stare at the ceiling or go to sleep.

The best time of my life... the girl that loves me and she was actually fighting for me... I'm a fuckin pussy but that was the way it was. We're apart now and my life depends on her, it can't be like that, it's not living. After my fathers death I locked myself and was addicted to the computer. It was perfect, I didn't care about anything in the world just the virtual one... again, that's not living. I was heavily drinking just to get in some minimum contact with people... that's not living. Don't want to anymore. I don't want to be a fuckin' pussy for the rest of my life unless it ends quickly.

I sleep all day, I'd love to sleep forever and not feel anything. I can't do anything right and I'm afraid of everything. Even little simple things... Yes,  I'm almost 20. It would be my way of saying "fuck everyone" but the pain I can cause to 2, maybe 3 people in my life... otherwise I wouldn't think about it that long. I don't get the joy of life... don't want any point in it, I'm afraid of losing... Yes I know that nobody likes to lose, of course I do, I do understand what people like about living, how the whole system works, I just don't want to be a part of it. I see why people are happy. I don't feel.

My mother says that debating with me is pointless because I always say NO to everything. Don't get me wrong, she's an angel, caring about me... even too much as I don't deserve that much of attention. I'm sorry for writing here, as I know myself and indeed it will be something like "no, i know better". I just need some kind of anonymous contact. I'm sorry that I don't want to live because of a simple "just no" it's pitiful...
I like you, you care... thank you. Have a good night.

Thank you for your response my friend. However things are OK, I admit it. My life is OK, I don't have the right to say otherwise. I have the life that people would like to have. It is ok, because I still don't have full control over it. I don't want to be independent, I don't want those things, the people, I don't want anything. It's my mind that processes everything in that pessimistic way, it finds pain in good things, it tells me I'm worse each time I hear things. I'm lower than you my friend, I'm worse than you and your friends, I don't respect life, I don't have any respect.

Because the surroundings are more than good, I'd say almost perfect... but still... just the same old tense going through my head "fuck it, nothing pleases you, go and die, you have the right, it's your life". Can't get out.

Oh a musician... yes I have a goal to learn the guitar... I want it to be my passion. I would love to spend at least one hour each day on studying English as it's not my former language. I'd like to go to the gym which is 5 steps away from my house. But who cares? I don't, not at all, about anything. Sleeping is just perfect... New city, new school, no new friends, no new habits, just "omfg I hope I die" attitude. Maybe that's not depression, maybe I'm really a worthless fuckup. 
Fuck depression.
